evidence.evidenceSummary: Full implementation handoff for the document processing pipeline.

knownFacts: Test Plan defines 15 unit tests and 3 E2E tests.
All dependencies are pinned to known-safe versions.
assumptions: The OCR vendor API key is available in the secrets manager.
The staging environment matches the architecture spec.
unknowns: Performance under 10,000 concurrent uploads not yet tested.

riskNotes: OCR vendor API has a 99.5% SLA; plan for degraded mode if SLA is breached.

implementationHandoff.taskScope: Implement the full document processing pipeline including upload, OCR extraction, field mapping, and CSV export.
implementationSteps: Create POST /api/documents/upload route with file validation.
Build UploadZone React component with drag-and-drop and progress indicator.
Implement OCR service wrapper with retry and timeout logic.
Create POST /api/documents/extract endpoint that triggers OCR.
Build ReviewTable component for confirming and correcting extracted fields.
Implement CSV export service and GET /api/documents/export endpoint.
Add unit tests for upload, extract, and export routes.
Add E2E test for the happy-path upload-to-export flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload accepts PDF and PNG files up to 10MB.
Extraction completes within 30 seconds for documents under 5 pages.
CSV export includes all extracted fields with correct types.
All unit and E2E tests pass.
Security scans report no high or critical findings.
securityScans: File upload size and type validation in place.
